summary: Tested NEW features (story emoji reactions, /api/directory/trending, trending strip UI, founder card data) plus previously untested regressions (feed likes, comments, story create/grouped list, discover). Backend: 16 new pytest cases + 4 prior regression tests all passed (20/20). Frontend: login, feed, post create, like toggle, comment add, story composer upload, story viewer emoji react (add/toggle/switch highlight+count), trending strip, founders tab all verified working. One confirmed UI defect: story viewer close (X) button is unclickable because .story-nav.right overlay intercepts pointer events. Also flagged auth-playbook deviations (no brute-force lockout, wildcard CORS with credentials, seed admin never updates existing password).

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout: 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all return plain 401 and the correct password still succeeds immediately. Playbook requires lockout after 5 failures.
Admin is only inserted when missing; if ADMIN_PASSWORD changes the existing admin password is never updated (playbook requires idempotent update). Seeded admin doc also lacks created_at.
allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True; should be explicit origin list (from env) for credentialed httpOnly cookie auth.
Ranking loads up to 1000 docs per collection into memory per request and does one users.find_one per top user; will not scale. Consider aggregation pipeline. Not a functional failure.

ui_bugs.issue: Close (X) button is not clickable - '.story-nav.right' (z-index:2, top:0/bottom:0, width:40%) covers the story header and intercepts pointer events; Playwright normal click times out and document.elementFromPoint at the X centre returns story-next-button. Users must click the backdrop to exit. Fix: give .story-header/.story-close a higher z-index (e.g. 5) or start .story-nav below the header.

integration_issues.issue: Viewer auto-advances every 5s and calls onNextGroup when the last story ends, so a reaction can land on a different story than intended; also react() has no try/catch, so a failed POST /react throws an unhandled promise rejection with no user feedback. Functionally reactions worked (add -> 'active' + count 1, second click -> removed).

issues: Trending card #4 is visually clipped at the strip edge with no scroll affordance (arrow/fade), so users may not realise the row scrolls horizontally
Many seeded/QA users show placeholder text 'Department not set' and an em dash for bio - acceptable but noisy; consider hiding empty fields

action_items: HIGH: Fix story viewer close button obstruction (raise z-index of .story-header/.story-close above .story-nav, or offset .story-nav top by header height).
MED: Wrap StoryViewer react() in try/catch and surface an error state; consider pausing the 5s auto-advance timer after a reaction/interaction.
MED (playbook): Add brute-force lockout after 5 failed logins per email/IP.
MED (playbook): Make seed_admin idempotent - update password_hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD differs.
MED (playbook): Replace wildcard CORS origin with explicit origins from env since allow_credentials=True.
critical_code_review_comments: .story-nav (z-index 2, full-height 40% panes) overlaps the story header and close button - the only reason reactions still work is their z-index 6.
StoryViewer mutates the prop object (current.reactions = r.data.reactions) instead of lifting state; grouped story data can go stale on refetch.
GET /api/feed returns raw docs via _post_shape which pops _id but does not project it out at query time; safe today but a projection {'_id':0} is cleaner and consistent with other endpoints.
/api/discover returns every user (limit 50) with no pagination/auth requirement; directory data is publicly readable including emails.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed student users (TEST_student_*@nsec.edu / test-pass-2026), TEST posts/comments, and TEST stories (tiny base64 PNG) under admin@nsec.edu. Left in place so trending/story data remains available for the next agent.
test_credentials: admin@nsec.edu / nsec-admin-2026 (founder) from /app/memory/test_credentials.md - verified working; bcrypt hash confirmed $2b$12$ prefix; httpOnly cookies (access_token/refresh_token, Secure, SameSite=None) set on login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_stories_reactions.py covers story reactions (add/toggle/switch/invalid 400/401/404/422), trending directory (sorted, activity ints, no _id/password_hash), feed like toggle + comments, and discover. All 20 backend tests pass. Frontend verified end-to-end except the story close button obstruction. Story reaction UI tests are timing-sensitive (5s auto-advance) - react immediately after [data-testid=story-viewer] appears.
rca_of_the_issue: Story close button: .story-nav{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:40%;z-index:2} in App.css spans the full frame height including the header row, so the transparent 'next' pane sits above .story-close (no z-index). elementFromPoint at the X centre resolves to story-next-button, confirming interception. Reaction buttons escape this because .story-reactions has z-index:6.
